title: Quiet test reporter
goal: A test run prints failures in full and the totals; the full report goes to an ignored file
acceptance: core/tools/quiet-reporter.mjs prints each failure in full and the summary counts; a second reporter writes the complete spec report to an ignored file
APPLY shows the test script with both reporters; a test proves a failure and a test's log are not lost
privacy: Tool and rule text only; fixtures invented.
escalation: Quieting an output must never hide a failure: anything that fails is printed in full

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
